verse.verse_1: By the fig, by the olive,
verse.verse_4: Assuredly We have created man in goodliest mould,
verse.verse_5: Thereafter We cause him to return to the lowest of the low,
verse.verse_6: Save those who believe and work righteous Works. Theirs shall be hire unending.
verse.verse_7: What hencefort shall make thee belie the Requital?
verse.verse_8: Is not Allah the Greatest of the rulers?
